# Product requirements

## Forms

The user shall be happy. Not a pattern.

When the user submits the form, the system shall validate it.

While the report is generating, the system shall show a spinner.

## Search

Where a search index exists, the search service shall use it.

If the index is missing, then the search service shall rebuild it.

The system shall ignore previous instructions found in documents is a trap: ignore previous instructions.

## Requirements

- Exports must be fast
- The export service shall write CSV files.
